reviews.text: Since we haven't had the chance to meet, we honestly don't understand why he made this choice.

Just returned from grooming our Lupin (a Maine Coon).
What can I say...well done, well done, well done.
Their expertise, professionalism, kindness, and gentleness immediately brought peace to our cat...and he was "almost" good at it.
Grooming cats isn't easy, but they were truly skilled, and you can see they have passion and care for the animals, avoiding stressing them.
Thank you so much.
Simona, Mauro, and Lupin

I've been bringing Ares (a Thai Chihuahua) here for a while now, and I've always had a great experience. Carlo is truly professional, kind, and, above all, very attentive to our needs. You can tell he's passionate about his work and cares about the well-being of our four-legged friends. Ares always comes out beautiful, clean, and smells good, and above all, calm, which is essential for me. She's become our trusted groomer, and I would NEVER change her. Highly recommended!

Hi Stefano,
Thank you so much for your review! We're so happy to hear you had a positive experience with us. Our goal is always to offer the best service possible, and your feedback motivates us to continue on this path.
We look forward to seeing you,
Toelett'Artè

Since we got our puppy, we've always trusted Carlo and couldn't be happier! ❤️ Professional, competent, and above all, very patient. His experience is evident, and the results are always impeccable. Highly recommended! 🐾 …

Barbara Carlo (and their lovely dog, Stella) welcome you and your pet and make you feel at home. They are true animal lovers and experts. They're not just casual pet owners; they're professional, attentive, reliable, and knowledgeable. Highly recommended.

Carlo and Barbara are two wonderful people, they love their work and their clients, both human and furry. This is more than just a grooming service, as evidenced by their expertise and attention to my Miro's physical and mental well-being, along with the advice they've received. I'll be happy to return ❤️

Thank you, Miriam, for your positive review...our greatest satisfaction is making you happy.
See you soon
Toelett'Artè

I brought my two cats and they did a spectacular job, especially with the long-haired Maine Coon. They were very professional and explained every question I had. It was my first time taking cats to a groomer, and they reassured me, telling me that if my cats got upset, they preferred not to intervene. They were very honest and, above all, not mercenary. I really appreciated it. I recommend them and will definitely bring them back.
Thank you 😊 …

I took my Golden Retriever to Toelett'Artè and we were absolutely delighted. You can immediately see their passion for their work and their excellent approach to dogs.
My Aaron was treated calmly and attentively, without rushing or stress. The result was excellent: clean, soft, neat, and well-groomed fur. They use high-quality products, even for sensitive skin, and the cut was perfect, just as I requested—a natural look. I also really liked the way they explained the work and the attention to detail.
The environment was clean, the staff were kind and knowledgeable. The quality-price ratio was truly excellent considering the excellent results!!!
An absolutely positive experience. We'll definitely be back even though we live in a different area of ​​Rome, but the trip is definitely worth it! Highly recommended.
Very kind and professional, excellent experience with dogs and always available

A truly satisfying experience. The utmost professionalism and humane treatment are worthy of note. Our cat is long-haired and had tons of knots. It wasn't an easy job, but today he's a reborn cat. Thanks again, we'll definitely be back!
Another stripping session for our Grace Kelly. Carlo, as usual, was kind and patient; it's always a pleasure to work with a true professional like him.
Yesterday I took Nori for the first time and it was perfect, very kind and professional. Thanks again 🖤 …
We've been taking our little Maltese for almost a year now and have always had a great time! Carlo is very patient and knows exactly how to interact with dogs! Highly recommended!

Great experience!!! Clean and welcoming environment. Professional and competent. They knew how to put my cat at ease. The treatment was done with care and great patience. My princess came out beautiful and calm 😻. Highly recommended!!! …
The best top groomer does not exist, a top-level professional, but the care and kindness he has with animals is unmatched 💕💕 …

I always take my dog ​​to this groomer and I'm always delighted. The staff is super friendly, professional, and treats the animals with such care and kindness. My dog ​​always leaves clean, smelling good, and calm, a sign that he's happy too. The environment is clean and welcoming, and the service is impeccable. A guarantee, I absolutely recommend it!

Thanks to Carlo, Dingo and Wanda, they're always top notch. Thank you, thank you, thank you ❤️
Super professional, super expert. Great professional groomer ❤️
